items.name: OpenAI GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
items.summary: OpenAI rolled GPT-6 into ChatGPT for all tiers on Oct 7-8, adding "Intelligent UI" - answers composed from text, visuals, charts, forms and interactive tools the user can operate inline, with answers starting to stream 44% sooner. It shifts ChatGPT from a text chatbot toward a task-specific software generator.

items.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic's third Claude 5.5 release (Oct 7): its cheapest, fastest, most capable small model at ~75% cheaper than Haiku 4.5, with 1M-token context, 128K max output, and the first Haiku with adjustable effort / adaptive thinking. Benchmarked head-to-head against OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna, it anchors the high-volume agentic subagent tier.

items.name: Mistral Large 4
items.summary: Mistral's largest model (public preview Oct 6): ~1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal MoE, trained from scratch on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. Pitched as the strongest open-weight model built outside China, with weights promised by end of October - a European AI sovereignty play.

items.name: Reflection AI Beam
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection's first open-weight model (announced Oct 5): 501B-parameter text-only sparse MoE with just 23B active per token, pretrained on 23.8T tokens and RL-tuned on 10,500 GB300 GPUs. The pitch is inference efficiency - GLM-5.2-level reasoning at 3-4x less compute - positioning it as the Western open-weight answer to Chinese labs.

items.name: Nano Banana 2.1
items.summary: Google's upgraded image-generation/editing model (GA Oct 6, built on Gemini 3.6 Flash): 1K/2K/4K generation, up to 14 reference images for multi-image fusion, 4-character consistency, and clearer in-image text at roughly half the API price of Nano Banana 2. Rolling out across the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search, AI Studio, Flow and Stitch.
